hero.headline: Friend Battle Mode ⚔️
hero.subtext: Pick a game, invite a friend, and see who scores highest. Friendly competition makes learning twice as fun!

howItWorks.title: Choose a game
howItWorks.description: Pick any of the 118 games as your battle arena.

howItWorks.title: Invite a friend
howItWorks.description: Share your unique battle link via WhatsApp, email, or copy-paste.

howItWorks.title: Both play
howItWorks.description: You each play the same game independently — no cheating!

howItWorks.title: See who wins
howItWorks.description: Scores are compared and the winner earns bonus stars.

cta.headline: Ready to battle?
cta.subtext: Log in to start a challenge — your friends don't even need an account to accept!
